description: Living mountain - unbreakable defense with earth-shaking retaliation.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): only 7 confirmed Mountain King-tagged nodes (the smallest spec list of any class so far), expanded to 12 using the real tooltip-confirmed 'Other' bucket abilities that clearly belong to this spec's identity (Mountain Hammer, Judgement of the Three Hammers, Unyielding Form) rather than inventing new ones. Mountain Avatar confirmed as capstone: 'Damage dealt by Geode Barrage or Geodes now has a 5% chance to grant you Earthen Avatar for 5 sec... Become an avatar of the earth, increasing damage dealt and reducing damage taken by 15%, increasing melee haste by 20%... Immune to stuns, roots, and snares... Usable while stunned.'

nodes.name: Earthmother's Protection
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: Self-heal proc REMOVED 2026-10-28 on Kyle's direction to follow the CoA reference over earlier guidance. CoA's Mountain King tree has no self-heal in any of its 40 nodes, and the spec page says so twice: 'There is no self-heal in this kit - rely on mitigation (Rock Barrier, Boon of the Turtle, avoidance) and out-of-combat regen between packs rather than a heal spell.' Every Primalist heal in CoA lives in the class tree, which Frontier does not implement, so there is nowhere legitimate for one here. CoA's own Earthmother's Protection discounts Hand of the Earthmother while Rock Barrier is up; neither Rock Barrier nor that cost hook exists, so it carries flat Armor.

nodes.name: Quake
nodes.description: Increases the threat you generate by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: Fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): keyed to a nonexistent ability_primalist_earthquake_threat_pct - the real ability is primalist_quake, and this talent is even literally named 'Quake' already. Retargeted the ability_id, but left as a genuinely inert key: ability_<id>_threat_pct is not one of the engine's real per-ability talent suffixes (only _cost/_cooldown/_damage/_potency are read anywhere in Ability, see combat/abilities.py). A real per-ability threat multiplier doesn't exist in this engine yet - CombatEngine only reads class-wide low_health_threat_pct/threat_generation_pct, not an ability-specific one. Harmless, does nothing, flagged rather than silently built.

Lasts 15 seconds.' nodes.name: Earth Destroyer
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Mountain Fury by 4 seconds per rank and increases its duration by 1 second per rank.
nodes._source: Fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): 'Mountain Fury' in the description refers to the sibling talent node (primalist_mountain_king_mountain_fury) that grants Judgement of the Three Hammers - connected_to confirms they're linked, so the ability_id itself was already correct. But the cooldown value was -4, which INCREASES cooldown under talented_cooldown's formula (cooldown - reduction) instead of reducing it as the description says - same sign-flip bug found on 4 other talents in this sweep. Note: Judgement of the Three Hammers' own base cooldown is currently 0, so even with the sign fixed this talent has nothing to reduce - a separate, pre-existing gap on the ability itself, out of scope for this sign fix.

nodes.name: Mountain Avatar
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Geode Barrage or Earthquake has a 5% chance to grant Earthen Avatar for 5 seconds: increases damage dealt, reduces damage taken by 15%, increases melee haste by 20%, and grants immunity to stuns, roots, and snares. Usable while stunned.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed verbatim, kept as the Mountain King capstone - a strong proc-triggered defensive/offensive cooldown with real hard-CC immunity. Wired as a real proc: ability_filter restricts the chance to Geode Barrage/Quake specifically (Quake is this engine's real built ability standing in for the tooltip's 'Earthquake' - no separately-named Earthquake ability exists in data/abilities/primalist.json, and Quake is the closest real Primalist ground-slam AoE). 'Usable while stunned' needs no separate mechanic: nothing in this engine currently blocks a specific ability while stunned (TurnMeter.update() only withholds the TURN itself), and Earthen Avatar's own cc_immune stat_mod keeps the carrier from ever being stunned in the first place while it's up, which already satisfies the tooltip's intent.

nodes.name: King of the Mountain
nodes.description: Grants parry, dodge and haste equal to 1% of your Strength per rank.
nodes._source:
Was 'Mountain's Endurance', an invented node carrying a self-heal proc on every weapon swing. Replaced with CoA's real Level 20 free passive, which the spec page calls 'your main avoidance lever': 'King of the Mountain - Increases your parry, dodge, and haste rating by 15% of your Strength.' This is a real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion through the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py - parry, dodge and haste are all valid targets and strength a valid source - and it fixes the other half of the audit finding: CoA's stat priority leads Hit > Expertise > STRENGTH, and this tree previously had no Strength node at all, defending purely with +39% armor across three nodes.

MAGNITUDE CORRECTED: CoA's wording is '15% of your Strength', and copying that literally gave +17.5 to BOTH parry and dodge, because a level 60 Primalist in full gear carries 146 Strength here. Total avoidance reached 82.5% (44.8 dodge + 37.8 parry) and the spec stopped dying at all - it survived 908 turns against a field of 5-20. CoA's percentage assumes CoA's stat scales, not Frontier's. 1%/rank lands at ~+5.8 each, in line with the other tanks' avoidance.

WORTH FLAGGING SEPARATELY: dodge and parry are FULL avoidance here and nothing applies diminishing returns to them, so any two sources that stack linearly can walk a tank toward immunity. That is a systemic gap, not a property of this talent.

nodes._source: Was 'Stone Ward', invented (Nature damage taken). Added 2026-10-28 on Kyle's direction to follow the CoA reference. CoA's Mountain King survives on these two and Frontier had neither - the audit found five Mountain King talents referencing Rock Barrier while no primalist_rock_barrier ability existed at all. Removing the spec's invented self-heal procs left it with no sustain and no cooldown, 5 turns alive against a field of 5-21; these are the real tools that gap was asking for. stat_mods on an ability BUFF are percent points, not fractions - following primalist_boon_of_the_turtle's damage_taken_pct of -10 right next door, since talent effects use the opposite convention for the same key names.
